kernels.revision2: kernel v1 as in chips/INTERFACE.md revision 2: the tax of the kernel's own buys returns as inflow, buys are sized on a simulated curve and pair
kernels.idealised: no echo, every decided buy executes in full

amounts: integers as decimal strings: wei of OKB on the curve, token base units after graduation

steady.note: Constant inflow. The reserve must settle at a bounded level (leak = inflow share).

steady-small.note: A $1 buy every epoch (2.5e14 wei of tax).

steady-large.note: 2 OKB of tax per epoch (about 67 OKB of volume per epoch): far more than the reference curve can absorb. Shows the kernel's buy cap and the end of the curve.

surge.note: 16x surge for 8 epochs inside a steady flow.

ramp.note: Flow ramps up by 1.5x per epoch for 12 epochs and stays high.

drawdown.note: Slow bleed: 10% less tax every epoch.

crash.note: Flow falls 64x in one epoch and stays there.

drought.note: Steady flow, then nothing at all.

silence-return.note: Long silence, then the same ordinary volume returns. It must not be classed as a surge.

pause-return.note: Short pauses of 5, 3 and 7 epochs between runs of the same volume.

dust.note: Sporadic $1-$4 buys, about one epoch in eight, zero in between.

subdust.note: Inflows below the floor (1e11..8e12 wei). Nothing should be classed as live.

noisy.note: Lognormal tax per epoch (sigma 1.2), 15% empty epochs: a small token with a few trades per epoch.

noisy-dollars.note: The reference token's likely life: median $1.6 buys, 60% empty epochs. Half of the tax comes from one-way buys, which move the curve.

launch.note: Launch spike decaying 30% per epoch (one-way buys: 43 OKB into the curve), then ordinary noisy volume.

milestones.note: Cumulative tax crosses 0.009, 0.099 and 1.009 OKB: the allowance ratchet.

whale.note: One epoch with 3 OKB of tax (100 OKB of volume): the allowance ceiling binds.

graduation.note: Graduates at epoch 61 (an outside buyer takes the rest of the curve): tax is then 1e22 token units (10,000 tokens) per epoch.

graduation-busy.note: Graduates in the middle of a surge (in BANK); token tax is noisy afterwards.

witness.note: One epoch with 0.01 OKB of tax, then no outside trading. The shortest trace in which one input word is answered with two different routes.

hostile-timing.note: The 'noisy' flow settled at irregular gaps of 1..40 epochs (DT saturates at 15).

failed-buys.note: Two settles in three the Manager refuses the buy (BUY pause): the decided amount stays in the reserve and is offered again. (Idealised kernel: two buys in three fail and the third executes half.)

outage.note: Neither evaluator answers from epoch 100 to 139. settle() reverts for 15 epochs (the tax waits in the vault), then the fallback word routes until the evaluator is back.
